_materials_accessory: P-02 says "the rest is outfit or accessory" without saying which: weapon (武器), jewellery (珠宝), tassels (穗) and hair ribbon (发带, same family as the 发带 bones of P-01) are classified as accessories, the rest as outfit. Only used for the models missing from "materials".

fingers_gloved._note: Fingers whose surface is the outfit. Measured (dominant bone on the finger chain, P-02 group); no skin under the glove: the layer that gives the finger surface, the one read by the atlas finger passes (SQ, MP) after the skin alone fails, is the outfit. Elsewhere, skin first.

materials._note: ZZ-04 as a table: canonical class of each material, per model, classified by hand with the ZZ-04 rules in order (1. vertices welded and shared with the skin, 2. region of the dominant bone, 3. name). "doublet": "+" copy of another material (same faces), takes the group of "from". "mixed": material that carries several kinds of parts; each geometric island (P-05) takes the group of the majority of its vertices' bone families among hair, accessory, garment, otherwise "default". A "=Model" string reuses the table of another file (same material names). Missing class = unclassified, reported by IN.

Evelyn._why: takes exactly the groups of wave 1 (regression); 痣 is on the face (bone 頭)

NangongYu._why: 颜2: bones 口中/口左/口右, shares its vertices with 颜 and 口线 → mouth; 睫眉 = eyelashes and eyebrows in a single piece: class lashes_eyebrows (eyes group); 肌 exactly covers faces of 体 (duplicates): the skin wins at the weld

NangongYu-Muse._why: 饰 (ornament, bone 上半身) and 屏幕 (screen, shares 96 % of its vertices with 饰) as accessories

Phionie._why: 体肌+ and 体下肌+: "+" copies of faces of 体 and 体下, named 肌 (skin) → skin, the skin wins at the weld; 指甲 (nails) shares 63 % of its vertices with 肌 → skin (rule 1); 二重 (eyelid fold): added class, eyes group; 金属 as outfit, like on Evelyn; 药丸 (pills on the thigh), 翅膀 (wings) as accessories

Phionie-Peau-Noir._why: skin in four materials: 脖 (neck, bones 頭/首), 手 (arms and hands), 肌下 (legs), 指甲 (nails, 63 % shared with 手); 痣 is on the thigh here (bone 左足D) → skin, not face as on Evelyn; 眼罩 (blindfold, bone 頭) and the 饰 (ornaments) as accessories; 体-金属: bone Ctr_Ill_BowTie, like 胸前饰

Trigger._why: no iris, no sclera, no eyelashes: the model has no eyes (no 両目/目 bones); 耳 (ears, bone 頭) and 首 (neck, bones 頭/首) → skin, like the ears and neck inside 肌 on Evelyn; 饰: breastplate (Breastplate), tube, tape, head ornaments → accessory; 披风 (cape) → outfit

ZhuYuan._why: 髮 carries the hair but also the earphones (耳机), the pendant (挂件), the leg ornaments (腿饰) and the brooch (胸针) → mixed; 体饰: armbands (腕甲), weapon (武器1), leg ornaments; 体饰2: bone 挂件2
